title: Logout screen item focus not synced with multiple screens
line: With several screens, the logout screen's buttons now always appear on the screen the keyboard is typing into, so arrow keys move a highlight you can see.
explanation: Since 6.8 the logout screen has one set of controls that moves to whichever screen the pointer hovers, but the greeter opens one window per screen and KWin gives the keyboard to the window that maps last. The controls started on the first screen while key presses went to another screen's window, so arrows and Tab did nothing visible there and the highlight jumped once the pointer reached the other screen; the controls also did not come back when the window regained activation. Now Logout.qml moves the controls to its screen whenever its window becomes active, so the visible controls and their focus highlight always sit on the window that receives the keyboard.

commits.message:
desktoppackage/logout: Keep the controls on the screen with keyboard focus

With several screens the controls stayed on the first screen while the
keyboard went to another screen's window, so arrow keys moved an unseen
highlight. Now the controls move to whichever screen's window is active.

BUG: 390503

media.caption: Master, two screens, pointer on the left: after pressing Right twice no button is highlighted
With the fix: same steps, the highlight moved from Shut Down to Cancel on the left screen
Master: moving to the right screen shows the controls there with the highlight still on Shut Down; the earlier key presses were lost
With the fix: controls followed the pointer right and back left, keeping the highlight (moved there with Left), and Right twice moved it to Log Out

reviews.text: Small, well-targeted fix in Logout.qml that moves the shared LogoutControls instance to whichever screen's window becomes active via Window.onActiveChanged, keeping visible controls and keyboard focus in sync across multiple screens without breaking the single-controls hover behavior introduced in 6.8. Verified on a two-output Wayland setup for both keyboard navigation and cross-screen pointer movement, with no QML or single-screen regressions.

Since 6.8 there is a single set of controls, so the reporter's conflicting highlights now only happen when the controls sit on a different screen from the window with the keyboard. Moving the controls on Window.onActiveChanged, plus the existing hover requestActivate, keeps the single highlight on the window that gets the keys. This closes the bug at the right layer with a small, clean QML change. The before and after shots and the verify notes cover arrows, pointer moves both ways, Escape/Enter and a single output. Nitpick: on open, the controls land on whichever screen KWin activates last, which may not be the primary screen, but keyboard and highlight stay in sync either way.
